findings.observed_behavior: Three 1.3.0 atm-daemon processes ran concurrently under distinct ATM_HOME roots.
findings.expected_behavior: ADR-002 permits at most one atm-daemon process anywhere on the host.
findings.root_cause: Launch lock, owner lock, and IPC endpoint are all derived from ATM_HOME; tests explicitly accept separate gates for separate ATM_HOME values.
findings.notes: Release blocker. Replace per-ATM_HOME ownership with one stable host root and add cross-ATM_HOME process-level rejection coverage. No test-only exemption is permitted.

findings.observed_behavior: Smoke runner used removed --from/--as CLI flags.
findings.expected_behavior: Smoke scripts exercise the released CLI contract.
findings.root_cause: Harness retained pre-1.3 command syntax and was not tested against the packaged binary.
findings.notes: CLI syntax fix is present in this worktree; add installed-binary release preflight and daemon-count cleanup assertion.

findings.observed_behavior: Doctor direct-local-path unit test observes a live daemon and fails.
findings.expected_behavior: Unit test is independent of caller runtime environment.
findings.root_cause: Test changes HOME but leaves inherited ATM_DAEMON_BIN and daemon bootstrap context intact.
findings.notes: Clear ATM_DAEMON_BIN and other inherited daemon variables in the test fixture.

findings.observed_behavior: Local .atm.toml compatibility hooks suppressed the built-in Rust nudge.
findings.expected_behavior: Default 1.3.0 nudge path uses the daemon emitter without Bash configuration.
findings.root_cause: Dogfood configuration retained explicit post_send_hooks from the 1.2.3 nudge workaround.
findings.notes: Removed external hooks and verified the exact built-in template on pane %13 with message 01KXD2055FH1GV0QQG0ADTMRR7.

findings.observed_behavior: Raw daemon JSONL records error-level connection_worker failures during normal successful traffic while doctor remains healthy.
findings.expected_behavior: Successful traffic leaves no error-level daemon records, and log snapshot exposes every retained error consistently.
findings.root_cause: Connection-worker boundary logs a generic error after handle_connection returns Err but drops the original AtmError; snapshot queries a schema different from raw JSONL.
findings.notes: Classify expected disconnects, preserve error detail for actual failures, and add a zero-daemon-error success-path test.

findings.observed_behavior: Wrapper passes removed --as flag and fails before acknowledgement.
findings.expected_behavior: Team-mandated wrappers work with the installed release CLI.
findings.root_cause: Global compatibility wrapper retained the pre-1.3 caller-context interface.
findings.notes: Deleted the three global wrappers and backing scripts; startup guidance now uses native 1.3.0 commands.

findings.flow_or_command: atm doctor --json with one configured post-send hook
findings.observed_behavior: Doctor reports healthy and exposes no active post-send override.
findings.expected_behavior: Doctor presents an external hook as active post-send configuration.
findings.root_cause: Doctor loads AtmConfig but never projects post_send_hooks into DoctorReport.
findings.notes: Expose recipient matcher, resolved command argv/config root, and selected path for hook debugging; never expose payloads or environment values. A valid override must not degrade doctor health.
